description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationResolver class within the Aws\Configuration namespace. The class provides static methods to resolve AWS-related configuration values from environment variables, configuration files, or default values. It specifically handles retrieving configuration data for AWS SDKs, supporting profile-based and global configuration management.

classes.name: ConfigurationResolver
classes.description: Provides static methods to resolve AWS SDK configuration parameters from environment variables, INI files, and fallback defaults.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a configuration value based on environment variables, config files, or default value, following a specific hierarchy.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values from environment variables with a specified prefix.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Fetches configuration values from INI configuration files, optionally within a specified profile and section.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Determines the user's home directory across different operating systems.

methods.name: getDefaultConfigFilename
methods.description: Returns the default path for the AWS configuration file based on environment variables or the standard location.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts string values to specified types such as boolean or integer.

methods.name: retrieveValueFromIniSubsection
methods.description: Retrieves specific section and subsection values from INI files based on provided options.
